payload.rationale: The supplied official-source ranking places Why Did I Get Married Again? first among US Netflix films for September 7–13. That makes it a plausible, narrowly favored candidate to remain first for September 14–20, the week covered by the September 22 publication that determines settlement. This is a weekly US ranking, not the daily ranking on September 21. The estimate assumes some week-to-week persistence in audience demand; the prior first-place finish is observed evidence, but continued leadership is not. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is that the previous lead may have been narrow or driven by an opening-week surge, leaving the film vulnerable to declining demand or a strong competing release. The strongest reason it could be too low is that the film may have had a substantial lead and sustained viewing momentum, neither of which is visible in the supplied ranking. With no current-week trajectory, I give the incumbent only a modest edge rather than a high-confidence forecast.
limitations: No current-week US viewing totals, daily rankings, or audience trajectory are supplied.
The preceding-week ranking gives no winning margin or information about how long the film had been available.
The probability is a judgment based on assumed persistence, not a calibrated historical transition model.
